description: Use this when the user wants to compare accounts, within one bank or across banks. One call returns, for each product: monthly fee, annual fee before waivers, included transactions (checked against monthly_transactions if given), minimum balance, NSF fee, the fee-waiver conditions (summary and logic), e-transfer and ATM terms, and what is missing -- plus a ranking by monthly fee with the annual difference to the lowest. It never applies a waiver to the customer's balances: it gives the conditions so they can be checked. Products whose fee BLIA has not published are listed as not_ranked, never ranked as free. The ranking uses published monthly fee and nothing else: monthly_transactions adds a separate ranking_at_usage and the included-transactions check, and never changes ranking_by_monthly_fee. For one account's complete terms and rule logic use get_product_terms.

channel.description: How the account is opened. Default "any" (terms that apply whatever the channel).

cohort.description: Customer group the terms apply to. Default "current" (the standard offer). Other groups a product carries (e.g. "senior_60_plus") are listed per product as variants; pass one to get that group's terms. Case and punctuation are ignored.

monthly_transactions.description: Optional: the customer's typical debit transactions per month, checked against each product's included transactions.

product_slugs.description: 2 to 10 product_slugs from list_bank_products, from one or several banks.

province.description: Province: a two-letter code (ON, QC, ...) or a name such as Ontario or Québec. Default "ALL".

name: compare_products

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

coverage.description: What BLIA does and does not cover: product classes, institutions, kinds of information.

coverage_scope.description: The product class, institutions and lineup completeness the snapshot covers.

disclaimer.description: BLIA's disclaimer, verbatim. Include it when relaying values.

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

guidance.description: What to say and what to confirm with the institution at this age.

status.description: How old the snapshot is: current up to 30 days, aging up to 90, then stale.

freshness_warning.description: Repeats freshness.guidance when the snapshot is not current.

not_ranked.description: Products left out of the ranking and why; never ranked as free.

publication_seq.description: Publication number of the snapshot being served.

ranking_by_monthly_fee.description: Products with a published CAD monthly fee, cheapest first, ties by product_slug. Nothing else affects the order.

title: Compare published fees across products
